name: Shinsei Kourin Arcanarouge ~Hakudaku to Shokushu ni Kegasareshi Mahou Shoujo-tachi~
original_name: 神聖昂燐アルカナルージュ～白濁と触手に穢されし魔法少女たち～
source:
On the park one night,
I came across a battle unfolding between monsters and Magical Girls.
Those girls happened to be my students, from St. Étoile Academy.

They said,
"This world is being invaded by beings from another world, and so we're fighting to protect it"
An absurd explanation, yet it was proven true by the conflict taking place in front of me.

I thought about what I could do for my students, and so I decided to stay together with them, however...

[Translated from [url=http://www.chaos-r.com/chaos-04.php]the official website[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上在公园里，
我目睹了魔物与魔法少女之间的战斗。
那些女孩恰好是我的学生，来自圣星学院。

他们说，
“这个世界正在被来自另一个世界的生物入侵，所以我们正在努力保护它”
荒谬的解释，却被眼前发生的冲突所证明。

我想过我能为我的学生做些什么，所以我决定和他们在一起，然而……

[翻译自[url=http://www.chaos-r.com/chaos-04.php]官网[/url]]
